_readme: Settings of the water DPR workbook (dpr.py) - user decision 26-Oct-2026: the format of the Elmwood water estimate of U.P. Jal Nigam (Elmwood_water_ Estimate.xlsx), SOR items from sor_2025_26.json (= the estimate's sheet 'sor', checked code by code), the other rates and unit estimates as in the Elmwood estimate - yellow in the workbook, to be confirmed. 'src' says where each value comes from.

pipe_supply.src: Elmwood 'DS' I9:I20 (UPJN rate, Rs/m): HDPE PN-6 PE-100, DI K-7 - the same as items M.194 / M.193 of the UPJN (Fairview) 'Project preparation & construction rate 2025-26', Nirman Mandal Westbrook office memo 615/143 dt 22-08-2025 (Rate 2025-26.pdf) - inclusive of freight, loading, unloading and stacking at site, exclusive of GST and labour cess

pipe_supply_k9.src: DI K-9 pipes, Rs/m: item M.193 (x)-(ae) of the UPJN (Fairview) 'Project preparation & construction rate 2025-26', Nirman Mandal Westbrook office memo 615/143 dt 22-08-2025 (Rate 2025-26.pdf) - inclusive of freight, loading, unloading and stacking at site, exclusive of GST and labour cess; K9 where a rising main's K-7 pressure is exceeded (user decision 31-Oct-2026)

nrv_rate.src: DI DF non return valve (IS 5312 Part 1), Rs each: item M209 (c)-(n) of the UPJN (Fairview) 'Project preparation & construction rate 2025-26', Nirman Mandal Westbrook office memo 615/143 dt 22-08-2025 (Rate 2025-26.pdf) - inclusive of freight, loading, unloading and stacking at site, exclusive of GST and labour cess

specials.src: Elmwood 'DS' K21:K22: specials 5 % of the HDPE pipes, 10 % of the DI pipes

trench.src: Elmwood 'RC' E5: excavation = L x (D + 0.6) x (D + 1.0); road cutting width D + 0.6

road_share.src: Elmwood 'RC' F5:N5: shares of the pipe length under each road surface (one set for the project, change in sheet Project)

road_rates.src: Elmwood 'DS' I89:I97: dismantling / reinstatement rates from the unit estimates (Rs/sqm)

valve_rate_row.src: Elmwood 'SV Rate': row of each valve size (C = supply, E = fixing)

valve_of_pipe.src: sluice valve of each pipe: HDPE OD 110 / 140 / 160 -> 100 / 125 / 150 mm valve (Elmwood 'Summary DS' rows 35-46), DI the nominal size

prv_rate.src: INDICATIVE only - the PRV valve itself (pilot operated, DI body, PN 10, with its Y-strainer and pressure gauges) of the pipe's valve size (valve_of_pipe), Rs each, a yellow quotation rate to be replaced (user decisions 30 / 31-Oct-2026). In none of the user's documents (UPJN rate 2025-26, Riverside R3, Elmwood, SOR - searched 31-Oct-2026); IndiaMART listings (31-Oct-2026) only small or steam PRVs - a 2 inch pilot operated water PRV Rs 69,083. Its two isolating sluice valves (UPJN M208) and its masonry chamber (sheet SV M) are items of their own in D2.

valves_per_oz.src: Elmwood 'Summary DS' rows 47-49: per zone 1 fire hydrant, 1 scour valve, 2 air valves

valves_rule.value: one sluice valve on every pipe closed at an OZ / DMA boundary and on every DMA inlet, of that pipe's size, and one at each OHT outlet
valves_rule.src: this app (CPHEEO Table 2.7 S.No.18, 21: each OZ / DMA hydraulically discrete, one inlet) - the Elmwood estimate counted them by hand

chambers.src: Elmwood 'DS' I101:I105: chambers from the unit estimates; masonry above 125 mm, surface box up to 125 mm; scour valve chamber at the surface box rate

crossings.src: Elmwood 'DS' rows 77-78 (rate from the unit estimates; numbers of crossings are of the project - 0 here, fill in)

thrust.src: Elmwood 'DS' rows 106-122: one RCC thrust block per 200 m of DI pipe; volume 'Thrust <d>'!D46, steel D47

material: 20 mm dia GI pipe class B

house_connection.src: Elmwood 'NEW HC': analysis of rate per connection (rows 134-165), material x 1.2 / 1.4 / 1.6 / 1.75 for bigger mains, 1.2 sqm of road per connection; connections shared by pipe length of each band

oht_ugr_rates.src: U.P. Jal Nigam 'Standard Cost of Over Head Tank (OHT) of 25 M Staging' and 'of Under Ground Water Reservoir (UGR)' for FY 2022-23 ('Say' rows, Rs per litre; average of UPJN order 1344/2042-0026/13 dt 23.11.2013, Meerut Circle order 1710/615/13 dt 03.08.2019 and SWSM, 7 % escalation a year; UGR = 3/4 of OHT; GST and labour cess extra) - user decision 26-Oct-2026: linear interpolation between capacities (at the ends the end rate), 7 % a year to 2025-26 (3 years); user decision 6-Nov-2026: as the Riverside water DPR (p213-272: e.g. 750 KL CWR Rs 12.25 / litre = the table's FY 2022-23 rate) no escalation - years 0, the escalation cells kept (yellow) to change

oht.src: Elmwood 'OHT Z-7' row 10: the rate at 25 m staging, +/- 15 % for every 25 m more / less (user decision 26-Oct-2026)

cwr.src: Elmwood 'CWR': Rs 50,000 soil testing per CWR; the rate per litre: oht_ugr_rates (UGR)

swd.src: CPHEEO Table 2.7 S.No.12 p175: side water depth up to 1 lakh litres 3 m, up to 10 lakh 4 m, above 5 m

pump.src: Elmwood 'T3 (1)' rows 39-185 (pumping hours and tube well discharges: criteria.json): pump efficiency 72 %, terminal head 1 m, chlorine 0.5 ppm as 10 % sodium hypochlorite; friction 5 m an allowance until the rising main is designed. User decisions 6-Nov-2026 (as the Riverside water DPR): the tube well's water 15 m below GL + seasonal variation 5 m + depression during pumping 4.5 m (DPR p130-196 'Calculation of static head', most zones; zone 1 28 + 3 + 3.5) in place of Elmwood's 6 m; the motor margin by its kW as the CPHEEO table of DPR p360 (up to 1.5 kW 50 %, 3.7 40 %, 7.5 30 %, 15 20 %, 75 15 %, above 10 %) in place of 20 % on every motor. A tube well filling a CWR lifts to the ground level (cwr_water_above_gl_m 0): Riverside water DPR p136-195 'Calculation of static head', TW to CWR - staging 0, depth of water in tank 0 (user decision 6-Nov-2026, in place of the CWR's full side water depth above ground). The CWR pumps (CWR to OHT, the same DPR pages): staging + depth of water in the OHT + terminal head + depth of the sump at the CWR 7 m + the friction of the short CWR - OHT main (DPR 0.08-0.11 m on 50 m of 350-400 mm; 0.5 m here, the main not designed) - user decision 6-Nov-2026, in place of a 5 m allowance for the losses

demand_factors.src: Elmwood 'T1' AU:BC: demand of the distribution network x 1.11 / 1.14 / 1.15 (losses 10 % + 1 % / 4 % / 5 %)

lump_sums.src: Elmwood 'ABS Com': parts of the project not made from the network design - 0 lakh here, fill in (phase 1, user decision 26-Oct-2026); the E&M works and the power connections: sheet EM (dpr_em.py, user decision 26-Oct-2026); the civil works of the Riverside water DPR (pump houses, site development, staff quarters, GW recharge, MCS, panel rooms, repairs of OHTs) from their estimates (dpr_civil.py, user decision 6-Nov-2026)

cwr_pump.text: VT / HSC clear water pump with motor

dma_auto.src: Riverside water DPR (U.P. Jal Nigam 2026) p55 'DMA equipment details in all zone 1 to 15' and p329-331 (estimates for automation for DMA site equipments, 200-450 mm) - user decision 6-Nov-2026

transformer.text: 11 / 0.4 kV transformer of a CWR sub-station
transformer.src: Riverside water DPR p342 (R3 'CWR LT Panel & sub sta'): 160 kVA Rs 513146; other ratings by the exponent - assumed (user decision 6-Nov-2026: the design gives the cost)

tw_scada: SCADA automation of a TW (PLC / RTU, GSM modem)
rebore_cable: Connection, laying & replacement of old LT cable incl. accessories and labour for a rebored TW, submersible cable from it to the existing pump house (the shifting of its power connection: R3 'Report' A21)
cwr_pp_rest: CWR pumping plant except the pumps (valves with actuators, specials, 5 T gantry crane, flow meter, dewatering pump, solar, cable, erection)
cwr_scada: SCADA automation of a CWR pumping plant
cwr_sub: LT / HT panels with sub-station for a CWR except its transformers (APFC, soft starters, HT panel, cables)
R3 'CWR LT Panel & sub sta' F40: 86.42 less 2 x 160 kVA transformers 2 x 5.13146 (Riverside water DPR p342)

R3 'pp oht BOOSTER' booster B167-B170, 'Gen Abs' E25
lcs: Local control station (LED wall, servers, UPS, printer, solar) - one for the scheme

em.src: U.P. Jal Nigam E&M estimate 'Riverside R3 dt 29.1.2026' (Construction Division E&M, Springfield; Riverside extended area sub zone 1-15, AMRUT 2.0) - user decisions 26-Oct-2026: E&M and its O&M in this format for every OZ from the design, new tube wells from the +15 years pumping main demand (sheet TW), a size between two of R3: linear between them, beyond: by the size ratio (exponent of the end pair). Booster pumps: R3 1 W + 1 S up to 37.5 LPS, 2 W + 1 S from 42.5 LPS (40 LPS a pump). Standby pumps (booster, CWR) and standby tube wells by the working ones as CPHEEO water manual Part A (2024) 5.7.5 p245-246: criteria.json standby_pumps (user decisions 7-Nov-2026). A rebored tube well (R3 'Gen Abs' B19-B27, B91-B98): its boring, pumping plant, SCADA and trial run as a new one, the LT cable to the existing pump house (rebore_cable), no new power connection. O&M: R3 '5year O&M revise' (staff, fixed charges Rs 375 / kVA / month, Rs 8.60 / kWh, duty 7.5 %, chlorination Rs 6831 a TW a month, repair 3 % of the E&M cost from the 3rd year, 5 % a year, GST 18 %)

em_design.src: Riverside water DPR (U.P. Jal Nigam 2026) E&M design and estimates - user decision 6-Nov-2026 (the E&M design sheets give the cost): tw = p357 'Calculation of pea gravel' (caving 50 % for fine sand, 10 m3 for development) and p358-359 'Design of drilling and size of pipes' (vertical velocity 0.6-1.2 m/s, 200 mm for 1200-1500 LPM and 150 mm for 1000 LPM, slot 3/64 x 3 in: 20 % opening area x contraction 0.5, entrance velocity 0.015 m/s (max 0.03), 0.30 m plain at both ends of 7 pipes of 6 m: 3.90 m as written, pipe O.D. + 14.2 mm, gravel shroud 140 mm, housing pipe: pump O.D. 143 + verticality 100 mm, O.P. unit bowl 183 mm, column pipe 150 mm; drilling 10 % deeper than the assembly), lengths as the quantities of p319-320 (housing 60 m, assembly 60 + 130 = 190 m, drilling 65 + 35 + 110 = 210 m; the p319 text says 180 / 200 m). tw_rates = p319-320 unit estimate (= SOR p362-364 of the CE (E/M) U.P. Jal Nigam: drilling 1.2 / 1.3, lowering 5.1 / 5.2, pea gravel 12.10 Springfield Rs 7000, development 6.2 / 6.2.2 / 6.4 / 6.4.2; the M.S. assembly at SOR 4.2-4.4 (2080 / 2760 / 3990) x 1.35 as p319: 300 mm 5386.5, 200 mm 3726; 150 mm 2808 by the same ratio). load = p356 'Calculation for capacity of transformer' (light & fan 2 kW, pf 0.8, 20 % additional, the next departmental rating). pc = p345-349 'Estimate for power connection transmission line' (TW: 25 / 63 kVA transformer with D.P. sub-station Rs 298167, processing Rs 119, security Rs 4500 / kVA of the load, energy meter Rs 37500, 11 kV underground double circuit line Rs 2461.68 / m, 540-575 m; CWR: processing Rs 5950, meter Rs 45000, 560-720 m, load 140 kVA for 136.80). cwr_el = p350-351 (motor efficiency 90 %, misc load 10 kVA, full load current at pf 0.8 and 95 %, starting 2.5 x, 50 % short overload, short circuit 10 x, breakers 1.25 x, derating 0.87, 2 transformers 1 W + 1 S); the cable ampacities are indicative (3.5 core XLPE armoured, in air) - to be confirmed. cwr_pipe = p361 'Main piping & valves including common header' (column / suction 1.8 m/s, delivery 2.0 m/s, header 1.8 m/s; p351 1.6). trial = p352-353 'Three month trial & run cost' (0.5 ppm, sodium hypochlorite 120 g / L at Rs 55 / L (SOR p364 11.7), Rs 8.30 / kWh, fixed Rs 350 / kW a month, light & fan 2 kW (TW) / 10 kW (CWR), booster 0.5 kW and 12 h, operator Rs 12000 x 3 a month).

Jal Nigam, AMRUT 2.0, 2026; user decision 6-Nov-2026: the DPR export as that DPR): p203-204 pump house cum chlorination room - one a new tube well with a bypass chamber, a repair of the pump house of each existing tube well; p301-315 site development - water works campus wall 2 x 40 + 2 x 40 m (new OHT), each tube well site 2 x 10 + 2 x 10 m, less a 3.6 m gate each, repairs of the existing campus wall, interlocking approach road 35 x 3.6 + 25 x 3.0 m, earth filling 40 x 40 x 0.5 m (user: each new OHT campus, yellow), semi-circular drain 160 m and arboriculture Rs 25,000 a campus; p316 staff quarters (single room); p317 ground water recharge, one a zone; p273-276 HT / LT panel rooms (each CWR) and booster pump room (each booster); p205-209 rising mains: a 10 m bye pass at the OHT and a masonry chamber for each sluice valve. Rates: the unit estimates (p382 = Elmwood 'Summary (2)')
